interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] [b]One lemon soda[/b], please. The green bottle.
[color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] I took the parcel back. Hanh came to the depot asking for it before we opened.
[color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] Then an officer asked whether anyone had tried to collect Binh's things.

response_choices: Did you tell him about Hanh?

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] Officer Phuc. I gave him the delivery times. Those are written down, at least.
[color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] Keep your records. That was what he told me.
